acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: A beloved drawing goes missing from Mr. Ablao’s third grade classroom. The class holds a funeral for the drawing, which accidentally unleashes a much bigger feeling than anyone anticipated.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: The musicians in the orchestra for Phantom of the Opera tell reporter Jay Caspian Kang about what it’s like to play the exact same music every single night—for decades. And how they’ve learned to make their peace with it.
acts.credits: By Jay Caspian Kang; Produced by Miki Meek
acts.title: Music of the Night after Night after Night

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Elna Baker’s mom doles out some very harsh feedback for her daughter, which goes unnoticed for ten years.
acts.title: How I Met My Mother
